name: tenant-pi-memory-chain
description: Memory search that changes no memory data: a scoped UserPromptSubmit hook in shadow that measures the chain and adds nothing to the prompt, and the on-demand skill memory-search that searches OpenViking, Hermes and the personal LLM Wiki for one question, ranked by the local decision model. It works only in place from the clone: it imports ../openviking-pi/shared/.
